message.content: {"label":"browser_youtube_window","observations":["Mac OS style window frame with top controls (red, yellow, green buttons).","Safari-style tab and URL bar showing 'youtube.com'.","YouTube Premium interface header with search bar, create button, notifications badge ('9+'), and profile icon ('H').","Main content area with embedded video player displaying logos (Founders Fund, Polymarket, Lighter, Figma, Varda, etc.).","Video metadata underneath: title 'Brian Singerman: \"If SpaceX Didn't Work, Founders Fund Wouldn't Exist\"', channel 'Sourcery with Molly O'Shea', Subscribe button, like/dislike/share buttons, and expandable description box.","Right sidebar containing recommendation video list with category filter pills at the top."],"interpretations":["Desktop web browser running YouTube viewing an interview video.","The video content features a discussion about Founders Fund portfolio companies."],"uncertainties":[],"children":[{"label":"window_titlebar","bbox":[47,44,953,133],"inspect":false,"reason":"Standard macOS window controls, tabs, and URL bar."},{"label":"youtube_header","bbox":[47,133,953,205],"inspect":false,"reason":"Main navigation and search header of YouTube."},{"label":"video_player","bbox":[59,214,646,645],"inspect":true,"reason":"Examine video player controls, current timestamp, and embedded graphics detail."},{"label":"video_details","bbox":[59,662,646,890],"inspect":true,"reason":"Contains video title, channel info, action buttons, and text description."},{"label":"recommended_sidebar","bbox":[656,214,930,904],"inspect":true,"reason":"Sidebar list of related videos and category chips."}]}
